entries.00be7b6a2f540169: As the third phase (fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026) of its management vision “Vision2025,” the company has set key measures of “creating new corporate value,” “advancing growth strategies” and “rebuilding a solid management foundation.” Alongside deepening its core residential field, it is expanding sales activities into non-residential fields, overseas sales and new fields; with the residential market expected to shrink over the medium to long term, its policy is to further advance growth strategies and transform into a high-profit structure through cost-reduction activities and others. As important medium- to long-term management issues, it cites building a stable earnings base centered on the Interior Decoration Business, among others.
entries.0657b1acbffb5e0c: Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥23,253 million.
entries.1237dee3b2513a2c: The company has a wide lineup of interior decoration products ranging from curtain rails to blinds and partitions, manufactured at domestic plants in Tsukuba, Mitsukaidō and Hyogo and overseas plants in Indonesia and Shanghai. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company launched a series of new products for both residential and non-residential fields, including new wood blinds and curtain rails, the residential electric curtain rail “Regato Como” and the partition-dedicated curtain rail “Flow,” and it also conducts sales promotion activities such as exhibiting at trade shows.
